comment: Advisories the desk has read and is living with for now. Each one needs the reason the desk is not reached by it and a date the acceptance runs out, at which point it fails the build again and somebody looks properly. Nothing goes in here to make a build green.

accepted.title: Improper sanitization of $nor in sanitizeFilter may allow NoSQL injection
accepted.why: The desk does not use sanitizeFilter: it is switched off on purpose in src/db/connection.js because it rewrites the operator objects keyset paging builds. Nothing client supplied reaches a filter as an object, because every request body and query goes through zod first and comes out as primitives, and rejectMongoOperators refuses any body carrying a key that begins with a dollar. Reviewed against the advisory on 2026-07-09.
accepted.fixBy: mongoose 8.9.6, which is a patch bump once the rest of the 8.9 line settles

accepted.title: Regular expression denial of service via multiple route parameters
accepted.why: Reached through express 4.21.2. The desk has two routes with more than one parameter and both parameters are anchored public id patterns of a fixed length, so neither can be fed the repeated separators the advisory needs. Every request also has a timeout in front of it. The real fix is express 5, which is a breaking change the desk has not taken yet. Reviewed on 2026-07-09.
accepted.fixBy: express 5, once the middleware signatures are checked
